id: 07_How to test for peroxides using Quantofix dip strips
title: 过氧化物试纸检测
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/07_How to test for peroxides using Quantofix dip strips.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/07_How to test for peroxides using Quantofix dip strips/src.py

points.K2: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护
points.K3: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
points.K6: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风橱旁，手里举着一盒空白试纸
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood holding up a blank box of test strips and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲怎样用试纸检查过氧化物。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着一瓶有机废液走到通风橱前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a brown bottle of organic waste solution with a blank label to a fume hood.
shots.narration: 阿杰要测一瓶有机废液。

shots.scene: 小研拿着试纸盒走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank test strip box.
shots.narration: 小研说：跟着我一步步做。

shots.scene: 试纸盒特写，旁边溶剂瓶和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a blank test strip box next to icons of a brown solvent bottle and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 用试纸，测有机溶液里有没有过氧化物。

shots.section_title: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护
shots.scene: 小研站在通风橱前，穿实验服、戴安全眼镜和蓝手套，橱内几只棕色瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a fume hood wearing a lab coat, safety glasses and blue gloves; several brown bottles with orange and yellow labels sit inside the hood.
shots.narration: 检测在通风橱里做。
overlay: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护

shots.section_title: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护
shots.scene: 五个防护图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: safety glasses, a lab coat, gloves, long pants and a closed-toe shoe. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜、实验服、手套、长裤、包趾鞋。

shots.section_title: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
shots.scene: 小研打开铝制试纸罐，取出一条试纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in blue gloves opens a blank aluminum test strip canister and takes out a single strip.
shots.narration: 打开罐子，只取需要的试纸。
overlay: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区

shots.section_title: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
shots.scene: 试纸末端的测试区被红框标出
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a test strip with the small test pad at its end highlighted by a red frame. No people.
shots.narration: 拿的时候，尽量别碰测试区。

shots.section_title: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
shots.scene: 戴手套的手把罐盖立即盖好
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand immediately presses the lid back onto the blank aluminum canister. No people.
shots.narration: 取完马上盖好罐子。

shots.scene: 小研把试纸直接伸进废液瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dips the test strip straight into the brown waste bottle inside the fume hood.
shots.narration: 这是废液，可以直接蘸取。

shots.scene: 旁边的小烧杯被红框标出
shots.prompt_en: A small empty beaker beside the bottle, highlighted by a red frame. No people.
shots.narration: 不是废液，先倒少量到别的容器。

shots.scene: 整瓶试剂被弄脏的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a test strip dipped into a reagent stock bottle with dirty specks spreading, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得污染整瓶化学品。

shots.scene: 试纸轻轻甩动，旁边计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A test strip being gently shaken with motion lines, next to a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 甩掉多余液体，等待5秒。

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 空白说明书页，其中一段被红框标出
shots.prompt_en: A blank instruction leaflet page with one paragraph area highlighted by a red frame and a water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书写着：测有机溶液要加一步。
overlay: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 小研用滴管向试纸测试区加一滴水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a dropper to add one drop of water onto the test pad of the strip.
shots.narration: 在测试区加一滴水。

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 说明书上的这一段旁边出现感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The highlighted leaflet paragraph with a big exclamation mark icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这一步对准确度影响很大。

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 两条试纸并排，加水后的颜色明显变深
shots.prompt_en: Two test strips side by side: the left pad pale, the right pad clearly darker blue, with a color scale beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 注意看：加水前后，颜色差很多。

shots.scene: 水溶液瓶和有机溶液瓶都连到同一组步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Two bottle icons, one with a water drop symbol and one with a solvent symbol, both linked by arrows to the same row of step icons. No people.
shots.narration: 测水溶液也加这一步，保持一致。

shots.scene: 水溶液试纸旁打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A test strip for a water-based solution with a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 不会影响结果。

shots.scene: 小研把试纸贴近罐身的比色卡对照
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the test strip next to a color scale of blank blue squares on the canister.
shots.narration: 把测试区和比色卡对照。

shots.scene: 测试区由白变蓝的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a test strip pad changing from white to blue with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 有过氧化物，测试区会变蓝。

shots.scene: 瓶身的蓝色警示标签，记录行被红框标出
shots.prompt_en: A blank blue warning label on a solvent bottle, with the results row highlighted by a red frame. No people.
shots.narration: 在易形成过氧化物化学品标签上，

shots.scene: 小研在标签记录行上填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in the results row of the blank blue label with a pen.
shots.narration: 记下浓度、日期和签名缩写。

shots.scene: 试纸盒有效期一栏被红框标出
shots.prompt_en: A blank test strip box with its expiry area highlighted by a red frame and an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 试纸过期了，丢掉换新的。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着蓝色标签上的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a general warning triangle on the blank blue label of a brown solvent bottle.
shots.narration: 标签提醒：可能形成爆炸性过氧化物。

shots.scene: 棕色瓶盖紧，旁边太阳、空气、火焰图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tightly capped brown bottle; beside it icons of a sun, an air swirl and a flame, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 原瓶密闭保存，避光、避空气、避热。

shots.scene: 瓶口结晶、液体浑浊的瓶子图标，手停住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle with crystals around the cap and cloudy liquid, and a hand stopping before the cap, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 见到结晶、变色、浑浊，不要打开。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁安全部门图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a safety office building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 联系安全部门协助。

shots.scene: 标签上收货、开封、处置期限三栏和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank label with three empty date boxes and a calendar icon showing a ninety-day cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 登记日期，首检后每90天检测一次。

shots.scene: 超过限值的瓶子打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle icon next to a test strip with a dark blue pad, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超过100 ppm，就不能再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现通风橱、试纸和水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a fume hood, a test strip and a water drop.
shots.narration: 通风橱里测，有机溶液加一滴水。

shots.scene: 比色卡、标签和过期试纸盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a color scale, a blank label and an expired strip box crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 对照变蓝，标签记录，过期更换。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的通风橱前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy fume hood.
shots.narration: 按步骤检测，安全用溶剂，下次见！
